status: prepared; do not launch before study14 raw exports are durably backed up
objective: Predict one further cached step by transporting the original steering response through its complete memory, using the unchanged frozen decoder.
parent: study14 cached_state_response_v1; six original contexts, two original directions; new second-step steered outcomes have not been observed
state_equations: r2 = D_memory F2 * r_memory1 + D2_memory F2[q_memory1,q_memory1]
input: Force the normal second token, frozen before interventions; if it is EOS use the previously fixed token760. Record fallback cases; this is controlled fixed-token inference, not free-running generation.
intervention: Original block11 input on the preceding cached token only. No new residual intervention at this step: changes arrive through the incoming cache.
memory_reconstruction: Rebuild normal complete first-step cache once per context. Substitute every affected stored current K/V, full convolution, and recurrent tensor from study14. Preserve all unaffected state, old prefix KV and flags. Verify one reconstructed actual calibration cache against a full native first-step repeat by whole-cache hash.
derivative_method: Seed incoming cache tensors with saved first-step memory tangents after the decoder has cloned the cache. Differentiate the actual next cached step with forward AD. Curvature comes from symmetric differences of these slopes at the original probe values. Value-difference fallback may be locked on calibration if forward coverage fails; never retune after new held outcomes.

numerics.selection: Largest adjacent pair passing both original calibration questions/directions; held checks use that locked pair.

readouts: All24 block interfaces, final hidden, current and preceding-token affected K/V, complete affected convolution and recurrent memory. Earlier prefix/unchanged states remain invariant controls.

primary.criteria: Inherit all study14 signed output-cost, weighted-logit, group-state and resolved-field gates. Delivery means changed incoming memory from the already verified prior intervention, not a new block11 residual change at this step.

optional_cubic_output_remedy.fit: No fitted coefficients. Estimate the third directional derivative from saved first-derivative slopes; require calibration coarse/fine agreement <=10% in weighted full logits and hidden response before freezing.
optional_cubic_output_remedy.targets: Four new next-step outcomes, only if four calls and export time remain. All forecasts precede outcomes; failure is preserved. One held reused question at a new position is not broad independent confirmation.

potential_energy_scope: Do not reuse the conditional h-only Jacobian symmetry test here: incoming memory now varies with steering, so transported h slopes contain memory terms. A full joint-state metric or separate fixed-memory probes would be needed to interpret potential-gradient symmetry.
limits: Known study14 contexts at a new prediction position; not new independent question families.
Direction-specific/context-specific local response, not an exact compact universal transformer or unknown-steering detector.
